newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, Metrocall in paging test.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, Metrocall in paging test.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp and Metrocall Inc said Monday that they are launching a four-month trial service, marketed under the name "Free 2 Me Paging," that will give customers paging service for the cost of a pager.
The companies said that the ongoing costs of the service will be borne by those who call the pager.
"With our new service, paging companies are able to offer their service to their customers without imposing the usual monthly fee," said Pat Hanley, Bell Atlantic Carrier Services president.
During the trial, callers to Metrocall's "Free 2 Me Paging" users will pay $0.35 per call.
Customers who call a user of Free 2 Me Paging will hear a recorded announcement advising them that they will be charged for completing the call.
